science.explanation: The Zero Point GPU Emulator is a hypothetical device that leverages quantum fluctuations to accelerate certain computations, potentially outperforming traditional GPUs in specific domains.
assumptions: Zero-point energy can be harnessed and manipulated at the scale of electronic devices
Quantum fluctuations can be used to augment computational power
